DDA Parks to Have Restricted Entry After Sunset, Enhanced Security

Delhi Development Authority (DDA) parks will implement restricted entry after sunset. Security will be increased in dimly lit areas, and night vigil will be enhanced. CCTV cameras will also be installed, and entry will be controlled.
